name: phone_action
description: Perform one action on the user's phone when this turn runs inside the a serve Android app. Actions: 'now' returns the phone's local date, time and timezone; 'calendar_read' lists upcoming events; 'calendar_add' creates one timed event; 'sms' opens the messaging composer for a contact with the text pre-filled (it never sends); 'alarm' sets a clock alarm; 'note' opens the share sheet with note text; 'location' returns one coarse position. Use this for direct requests such as 'what is on my calendar tomorrow', 'book 3pm tomorrow with the client', 'text Zhang San that I am late', 'set an alarm for 6 tomorrow', or 'what is the weather here'. Call 'now' before any action that needs a date, because the phone may be in a different timezone than this machine. Only available in the Android client; other clients return an error. Alarms and calendar events are created directly; the SMS composer still needs the user to press send, a note still needs the user to pick an app, and location asks for the Android permission on first use.

action.description: now returns phone local time; calendar_read lists upcoming events; calendar_add creates one timed event; sms opens the composer pre-filled; alarm sets a clock alarm; note opens the share sheet with text; location returns one coarse position.

days.description: calendar_read: how many days ahead to look (default 7).

title.description: calendar_add: event title. note: optional note title.

begin_local.description: calendar_add: start as local phone time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Call action 'now' first to learn the phone's date and timezone.

contact.description: sms: contact display name to look up on the phone. Provide this or 'number'.

number.description: sms: phone number to use instead of a contact lookup. Digits and + - ( ) . spaces only.

text.description: sms: message body (required for sms). note: note body (required for note).

hour.description: alarm: hour in 24-hour PHONE local time (call action 'now' first if the phone may be in another timezone). The request carries only hour, minute and label — no repeat days and no date are set, so it fires once at the next occurrence of that time.

label.description: alarm: optional label shown by the clock app.
